Indians Primarily Use Two-Wheelers for Commute, Public Transport Low

A survey indicates that 42% of Indians use two-wheelers for their daily commute to work, with walking being the second most common mode at 28.3%. Public transport is utilized by only 15% of workers for their daily commute.
